figure.learningGoal: Shows what a deserted medieval village looks like today: grassy earthworks with no standing buildings.
figure.caption: Grassy earthworks are all that remain of the medieval village of East Lilling, North Yorkshire, a typical deserted village site.
figure.alt: A grassy field with uneven humps and hollows, the earthwork remains of the abandoned village of East Lilling in North Yorkshire.
